hook: Beck has spent over 17 years inside Daimler's IT organisation, running IT for Daimler Trucks Asia and Mitsubishi Fuso from Tokyo before becoming CIO of Daimler Truck North America in 2018, where he also now heads IT for autonomous driving. He speaks German, English, French, and Spanish.
name: Lutz Beck

reading.body:
Lutz Beck is a career Daimler IT executive whose current role combines conventional enterprise IT leadership with responsibility for the IT infrastructure supporting autonomous driving at Daimler Truck North America.

His career shows a single organisation traversed across three continents. Starting in ERP and SAP implementation across Asia Pacific and Africa, he moved through European sales systems, finance and procurement IT, and then a six-year CIO posting in Tokyo before arriving in Portland in 2018. The pattern is one of successive enlargements in scope within the same corporate family rather than movement between employers.

The addition of autonomous driving IT to his portfolio is the detail most relevant to AI and compute. Autonomous trucking depends on onboard inference hardware, training infrastructure, and the data pipelines connecting vehicles to back-end systems. The data does not specify what compute resources or power capacity that work involves, how Beck's team relates to engineering or data science functions, or where the training workloads run. What it records is that the IT leadership for that function sits with a CIO whose background is enterprise systems management, which is an organisational choice worth noting without over-interpreting it.

timeline.impact: Heads ERP/SAP template implementation across Asia Pacific and Africa for Daimler entities, based in Singapore
Leads program management for a common European sales application reengineering and SAP template rollout across eleven countries
Heads IT management for wholesale sales Europe and commercial vehicle ordering

timeline.event: Executive Director, IT Management, Daimler AG
timeline.impact: Runs IT finance, controlling, procurement and business intelligence; serves on boards of Daimler Group Services in Madrid and the Philippines
Serves over six years as CIO for Daimler Trucks Asia and Mitsubishi Fuso Truck & Bus Corporation, based in Tokyo
Leads IT for Daimler Truck North America and heads IT for autonomous driving, based in Portland, Oregon

quick_facts: CIO of Daimler Truck North America since 2018, also heading IT for autonomous driving
Previously CIO of Daimler Trucks Asia and Mitsubishi Fuso Truck & Bus Corporation for over six years in Tokyo
